deviations.what: The sample's own css/style.css is injected since 2026-08-21 through an added core:HTML style leaf (no counterpart in the original view). It was archived but never reached the view, so the fixed and flexible halves lost the two blues (#D7E9FF / #A9CFFF) the sample is a picture of - the sibling port 119 already injected the same pair.
